title: Implement per-fd session state (crypto2dev_fd.c)
description:
Manage per-fd state for /dev/wolfcrypt streaming sessions. Rename wolfkm_session.c → wolfkm_fd.c.

Each open() gets its own wolfkm_fd_state. No IDR, no session IDs.

struct wolfkm_fd_state:
- spinlock_t lock
- bool initialized (set after WOLFKM_IOC_INIT)
- u32 algo_type (CRYPTO_ALG_TYPE_* from cra_flags)
- u32 op (ENCRYPT/DECRYPT/HASH)
- union { skcipher_request*, aead_request*, shash_desc* }
- u8 *inbuf, size_t inbuf_len (staging for write())
- u8 *outbuf, size_t outbuf_len (staging for read())
- u8 tag[16], u32 taglen (AEAD)

Functions:
- wolfkm_fd_init(file): kzalloc state, attach to file->private_data
- wolfkm_fd_configure(state, init_op): resolve algo via crypto_find_alg(), alloc wolfCrypt context, import key, memzero_explicit key buf after use
- wolfkm_fd_write(state, ubuf, len): copy_from_user, feed wolfCrypt update
- wolfkm_fd_read(state, ubuf, len): flush buffered output or finalize hash; for AEAD decrypt verify tag first, return -EBADMSG on failure
- wolfkm_fd_destroy(state): wolfCrypt Free for algo type, memzero_explicit entire struct, kfree

close() must memzero_explicit the full struct before kfree — FIPS requirement.
design: Use struct idr per open fd (allocated in wolfkm_cdev.c's .open). Session IDs are small positive integers from idr_alloc. A session struct contains: algorithm ID, union of wolfCrypt context structs (Aes, Hmac, Cmac, RsaKey, ecc_key, WC_RNG), and a spinlock for concurrent ioctl calls on the same fd. See DESIGN.md §Session management.
acceptance_criteria: 1000 sessions created and destroyed without memory leak (check /proc/slabinfo or kmemleak). Double-free of a session ID returns -EINVAL. Key material is zeroed (observable via /proc/pid/mem inspection in test).
close_reason: Stale: per-fd session state already implemented in src/cdev/crypto2dev_fd.c. Old issue used wolfkm naming and assumed IDR/session-ID design that was abandoned.
